additionalDocuments.label: Porto Playa original amenity plans (Mitchell’s mirror)

review.gallery: Eight original joint brochure renders and two October 2026 Ellington progress photographs show this development. Both developers identify the same beachfront project.
review.location: The RAK Properties project marker and the labelled joint brief aerial control. The JRE coordinate differs from the co-developer map and was not adopted. Fourteen estimates match the printed brochure driving table.
review.floorPlans: Twenty-six complete drawings: thirteen residence examples, ten residential plates and three amenity levels. The twenty-three drawing pages from the direct RAK Properties PDF are pixel-identical to those in Mitchell’s separately encoded mirror. The original application labels the 4 BR E317 layout as the Presidential Suite.

unavailable: Verified completed photography, surveyed visitor entrance, and separate plans for every area variant listed in the developer summary.
